svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Elevate: a personalised AI tutor on Google Cloud
Fully serverless: Cloud Run + Vertex AI (Gemini) + Firestore
1 Browser to Cloud Run over HTTPS
2 Backend to Gemini on Vertex AI
a PDF or a web link
Student lessons and homework, teacher dashboard,
Application Default Credentials, no API keys
source of truth, transactional learning updates
Composite index: events by student + time
Collections hold profiles, student models, lessons, activity and results
Each answer is graded by fixed rules, then updates the
student model (mastery, style, mistakes). Gemini writes
the next step, visuals and homework example to match.
Teachers add text, a PDF or a web link. Gemini drafts
lessons and homework questions; teachers review and
publish. Web pages are fetched with SSRF protection.
Mic audio goes to Gemini, which works out the intent
or answer. Tutor replies are spoken with Gemini TTS,
with sentence-level audio caching for quick playback.
Answer keys stay on the server; Gemini never grades.
A second Gemini pass blocks answer leaks; Vertex AI
safety filters are on; IAM roles are least-privilege.
